title: 'Iron Gate': US forms special task force to restrict Iran's land exports
summary_full: The United States has established Task Force Iron Gate to disrupt Iran's land and Caspian Sea weapons transport. This task force will operate from Tampa, Florida, involving approximately 20 personnel from various US government agencies. The initiative aims to further restrict Iran's capabilities to finance terrorism and rebuild military resources. Washington continues its naval blockade, reportedly preventing over $25 billion in crude oil exports.
